summary: The fabric DB endpoint (gunbc-roadmap-fabric-storage.service on srv1, `gunbc serve --entry dag/gunbc/fabric/fabric_storage_serve.dag --function fabric_storage_serve_handle --unix-socket /opt/gunbc/fabric-storage-door/door.sock`, proxied by `tailscale serve` at https://srv1.tailecbe08.ts.net:10000) stores content-addressed immutable objects and compare-and-set named heads (std.fabric_storage) under ONE root /opt/gunbc/fabric-storage with TWO namespaces: the legacy namespace (objects/, heads/: today 79 generations of `host-placement`, 4 of `pair-serving-authority-group-a`, and three D0 consent `cas-slot-*` slots; 87 objects) whose proxied writes are refused because the served writer roster folds to EMPTY, and the authenticated `/state` namespace (HMAC envelope under key id fabric-state-writer/1 from /etc/gunbc-fabric-storage/state-writer-mac-key) which is EMPTY today (0 heads, 0 objects). The only roadmap runtime read/write of the fabric DB is the /allocations family (gunbc.workspace_allocation_routes -> gunbc.workspace_allocation_http -> gunbc.workspace_allocation_store), one CAS slot per owner (`workspace-owner-<digest>`) holding a JSON ledger, written through gunbc.durable_cas_fabric_storage over gunbc.fabric_storage_binding fabric_state_storage_binding(); srv1's fabric-storage journal shows that path executing a read in production. NO task-shaped record exists in the fabric DB: seats/quota partitions are absent from the store today, compute/session capacity partitions live in a per-host LOCAL file store (/opt/gunbc/compute/capacity, gunbc.compute.host_capacity compute_capacity_store = FabricStorageLocalFiles), attempt receipts are per-instance files under /opt/gunbc/attempt-state, and the task record itself (gunbc.roadmap_model RoadmapNode) exists only as compiled rows in gunbc.roadmap_authority declared_roadmap_nodes() (plus projection-derived closing-contract tasks) with acceptance receipts in a committed jsonl -- every one of which needs a merge to main and a deploy (srv1 runs release revision 19b12d88d6c). Dynamic ASSIGNMENT of an existing node already exists at runtime but on a different carrier: POST /issue/{node_id}/assign appends a Claimed event to the roadmap event log (gunbc.roadmap.roadmap_event_carrier = git branch `roadmap-events`, 42 event files on origin), and assigning to the fabric workflow principal drives the same launch admission as /dispatch (serve_assignment_launch_follow_through_over -> belt_dispatch_node_for_instance_over with LaunchForClaim), which is the existing hand-off to the codex/claude backend. What is missing for runtime task CREATION in fabric storage is: a task record codec over RoadmapNode, a fabric-DB task store (one CAS slot per task plus a roster head, because std.fabric_storage has no listing operation), a create route with human write admission, a projection union so the belt/dispatch/issue page read runtime tasks beside authority rows, a composer page, and a runtime home for a task's acceptance receipts.

facts.fact: The fabric DB interface is immutable content-addressed objects (FabricObject { links: List<FabricObjectRef>, body: NonEmptyStr }, ref = fnv1a64 structural digest of the canonical preimage, explicitly a locator not a verification) plus compare-and-set named heads (one std.durable_compare_and_set slot per head); the only store operations are head, put, advance (ExpectHeadAbsent | ExpectHeadAt{object}; a lost race is FabricHeadMoved, not a fault) and closure (bounded walk of links, newest first). There is NO list/enumerate operation on the interface or on the wire.
facts.where: std.fabric_storage FabricObject, FabricObjectRef, fabric_object_ref_of, FabricHeadExpectation, FabricHeadAdvance, FabricClosureRead; gunbc.fabric_storage_client fabric_storage_head / fabric_storage_put / fabric_storage_advance / fabric_storage_closure / fabric_storage_presented_identity

facts.fact: CAS semantics over a head: gunbc.durable_cas_fabric_storage binds std.durable_compare_and_set to one fabric head `cas-slot-<key>` (cas_slot_head); every committed generation is one link-free object whose JSON body carries value, content digest and the generation it lands; fabric_storage_compare_and_set(store, VerifiedCasAttempt) observes the head (closure bound 1), compares ExpectSlotAbsent / ExpectSlotGeneration, puts the object, advances with ExpectHeadAbsent / ExpectHeadAt{observed object}, and answers CasCommitted | CasPreconditionFailed (re-observed) | CasStoreRefused. Attempts are admitted by gunbc.durable_cas_file_store admit_cas_attempt_for_derived_payload; a head/slot key may not contain '/' (cas_key_is_slot_addressable). Retention is never-released: every generation's object stays; the windowed reclaim (file_compare_and_set_windowed) exists only for local file roots, not over the wire.
facts.where: gunbc.durable_cas_fabric_storage cas_slot_head, cas_slot_object, fabric_storage_observe_cas_slot, fabric_storage_compare_and_set, cas_slot_advance; gunbc.durable_cas_file_store cas_key_is_slot_addressable, admit_cas_attempt_for_derived_payload; std.fabric_storage header (retention released-never)
